result.markdown:
The best payroll software for a small business depends on where you're based, how many employees you have, and whether you want payroll software to handle tax calculations and submissions automatically.

**My recommendation for 2026: Gusto is one of the best all-round options for US small businesses.** However, if you're operating in the UK, I'd recommend looking at different providers.

## A quick question so I can recommend the right one

Are you looking for payroll software for a business in the **UK or the USA**?

I ask because UK payroll has different requirements, including PAYE, National Insurance, pension auto-enrolment and HMRC Real Time Information (RTI).

If you're in the UK, I'd be comparing providers such as Xero Payroll, Sage Payroll, BrightPay and QuickBooks Payroll instead.

I can narrow this down to the **three best options for your business, including actual costs and pros and cons.**
